missions.text: Get two family members to high-five you in the same minute.
Make someone say the word "churro" without saying it yourself.
Start a family conversation about favorite villains without anyone noticing it was on purpose.
Get someone in your group to say "magical" without asking them to.
Get three family members to tell you their favorite ride without asking directly.
Make someone in your group laugh out loud using only a funny face.
Get someone to point at the sky without telling them to.
Get a family member to hum a Disney song without asking them to.
Use the word "bibbidi" in a normal sentence and get no reaction.
Get someone in your group to check the time without asking them.
Make two family members agree on the best snack in the park.
Get someone to say "Mickey" twice in one minute.
Convince someone to switch places with you in line using only a reason about the view.
Get a family member to share a funny memory from a past trip.
Get someone to say "I'm hungry" without bringing up food yourself.
Make the whole group look at the same thing at the same time.
Get someone to ask you a question about Star Wars.
Say three compliments to three different family members before the line moves twice.
Get someone to do a thumbs-up without asking for one.
Use the phrase "to infinity and beyond" naturally in conversation.
Get a family member to tell you what they'd name a pet dragon.
Make someone in your group say "yes" three times in a row.
Get someone to stretch their arms without asking them to.
Get a family member to name a princess without you saying "princess."
Slip the word "bayou" into a conversation twice without anyone noticing.
Get someone to tell a joke.
Get a family member to guess how long the wait is, without asking about the wait.
Get two people in your group to say the same word at the same time.
Make someone say "pirate" without you saying it first.
Get a family member to tell you their favorite color.
Get someone to yawn by yawning yourself, without them noticing.
Get someone to suggest a snack for later.
Get a family member to say "oh boy" like Mickey.
Get the group talking about what they'd do with one wish.
Get someone to describe their dream ride.
Use the word "fantastic" three times before your turn on the ride.
Get a family member to look at their shoes without asking.
Make someone in your group say "Goofy."
Get someone to pick between two snacks that you suggest.
Get a family member to tell you which character they'd want as a sibling.
Get two people to give each other a fist bump.
Get someone to say the name of a land in the park.
Get a family member to tell you what they ate for breakfast.
Make someone in your group wave at you from close by.
Get someone to say "ka-chow" without saying it yourself.
Get the group to vote on something silly, like best hat.
Get a family member to tell you their favorite movie this year.
Get someone to clap without asking them to.
Say a sentence where every word starts with M, and get someone to notice.
Get someone to tell you which villain is the scariest.
Get a family member to share their snack with someone else in the group.
Get someone to say "let it go" in a normal sentence.
Get two family members talking about dinosaurs.
Get someone in the group to make an animal noise.
Get a family member to ask you, "What are you up to?"
Get someone to name three ride vehicles: a boat, a car and a train.
Make someone in your group smile within ten seconds using only words.
Get someone to tell you what superpower they'd pick.
Get a family member to guess what you're thinking about.
Get someone to say "hakuna matata."
Get the group to count something together, like balloons you can see.
Get someone to tell you what they'd pack for a trip to space.
Get a family member to say a word that rhymes with "cake."
Get someone to describe their favorite character without naming them.
Get a family member to say "thank you" to you.
Get someone to suggest a family photo.
Get two family members to compare whose feet are more tired.
Get someone in your group to wiggle their fingers.
Use a pirate voice for one whole sentence and make it seem normal.
Get a family member to tell you the first ride they ever rode.
